title: Lula Invited Me to Brazil After His Electoral Triumph; I Also Invited Him to Mexico, Sheinbaum Says
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by La Jornada Editorial Staff originally appeared in the[October
27, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/27/politica/lula-invita-a-
sheinbaum-a-brasil-tras-triunfo-electoral-la-presidenta-le-responde-tambien-
con-invitacion), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

President Claudia Sheinbaum reported that her phone conversation with her
Brazilian counterpart, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, was brief but emotional
because he was very happy about his victory in the second round of the
presidential elections last Sunday. She shared that the talk was very brief,
during which **he invited her to visit Brazil** and, in turn, she also
extended an invitation for the Brazilian president to visit our country soon.
